instruction: Add animated background effects to the VS Code editor using the video file in Downloads.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not support animated or video backgrounds in the editor. While static background images might be achievable through certain extensions with custom CSS injection, video backgrounds are not supported and would severely impact performance.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly classified as infeasible - VS Code does not support animated/video backgrounds in the editor
